title: TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenant - Data API
description: Stores the list of tenants selected for a Security Center policy. For more information, see Define and Deploy Security Policies. This object is available to Security Center subscribers in API version 54.0 and later.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the policy for the selected tenant.

PolicyIdentifier.description: The ID of the security policy.

Tenant.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, it’s available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, it’s available in the specified API version and later.

- **TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenantChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenantFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenantHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenantOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **TenantSecurityPolicySelectedTenantShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
